description: This file defines a Flutter widget ExpenseLineChart for rendering a weekly expense line chart, including its associated painter class, as well as supporting widgets for axis labels. It relies on external models and Flutter's rendering system.

classes.name: ExpenseLineChart
classes.description: A widget that renders a simple line chart for weekly expense points.

classes.name: _XAxisLabels
classes.description: A widget that renders the labels for the X-axis representing weeks.

classes.name: _LinePainter
classes.description: CustomPainter responsible for drawing the line, fill, points, and grid lines for the expense chart.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the ExpenseLineChart widget with either a placeholder or the CustomPaint for the chart.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the _XAxisLabels widget with the week labels.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Draws the line, filled area under the line, points, and optional grid line on the canvas.

methods.name: shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines if the painter needs to repaint based on changes to points or color.
